title: CONNECT-IP Request Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP request initiation, URI expansion, encryption, recipient action, rejection, and non-success response abort policy.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpRequestPolicy` validates that tunnel initiation uses the `connect-ip` token for a single HTTP stream, delegates URI Template expansion to the CONNECT-IP template helper, requires TLS, QUIC, or equivalent encryption, chooses forwarding versus local proxy action from configuration, exposes request rejection permission, and classifies non-2xx proxying responses as client abort conditions.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper is stateless policy. It does not own HTTP connection state, upstream forwarding, or tunnel assignment state.
edge_cases_and_constraints: A correct token without single-stream association does not initiate a tunnel.
Unresolved URI Template variables fail before request dispatch.
Forwarding and local proxy behavior are mutually exclusive routing actions.
risks: HTTP/1.1 upgrade and HTTP/2/3 Extended CONNECT header validation remain separate request-format slices.
Tunnel variable extraction and address/route assignment remain later slices.
